summary: At the start of your Shooting phase, the selected friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER selects one visible enemy within this unit’s Nurgle’s Gift aura range and adds 6 to its detection range this phase. Source gap: detection range and the dynamic aura-range measurement are not defined here; confirm both before use.

Select an engaged friendly PLAGUE LEGIONS unit. All Is Rot permits shooting at enemies and on D6 5+ after damage may inflict 1 mortal wound on this unit after the attacker finishes. Source conflict: the shooter, engaged target and sacrifice recipient are not clearly bound; confirm the full shooting-into-combat procedure.
This enhancement unit re-rolls Wound rolls while within control range of a friendly-controlled objective. The source supplies no weapon-type restriction.

After a unit disembarks from this Chaos Land Raider, it may charge despite disembarking if this model made a Normal move this turn. Source review: the move condition uses this-model, the transport filter uses this-unit, and the subject allows any owner; confirm the friendly transport/unit binding and duration.

The selected friendly PLAGUE LEGIONS unit designates enemies within 6″ afflicted this phase. Source gap: no exact activation event or removal/refresh procedure for the afflicted state is supplied; confirm how this aura interacts with Nurgle’s Gift.
After this Defiler shoots in your Shooting phase, select one enemy it hit; that enemy loses the Benefit of Cover this phase.

Friendly PLAGUE LEGIONS using Deep Strike may set up at the encoded 6″ enemy distance while wholly within 12″ of the bearer. Source review: setup triggers another setup, without a strict more-than distance boundary; confirm replacement timing, arrival restrictions and which units qualify.
At the start of your Shooting phase, add 12″ to the bearer model’s plague wind Range this phase.
Once per battle per unit, at phase start, this Icon Bearer may select one Battle-shocked friendly DEATH GUARD unit within 12″; remove its Battle-shocked state.

Before the selected attached friendly DEATH GUARD unit shoots or fights, its Hit rolls score Critical Hits on the encoded value of 5 this phase. Source review: the effect does not specify unmodified rolls or a 5+ threshold; confirm the critical range.

Source conflict: the provisional effect targets this-model for returning, tests an unbound recipient’s keywords and does not bind the casualty count to this unit; confirm recovery, timing and placement.

In your opponent’s Command phase, roll 2D6 for each afflicted enemy: deal D3 mortal wounds on 7 or less if below Half-strength, otherwise on 6 or less. Source gap: this provisional effect has no activation event or frequency limit; confirm when each test occurs.

For a Death Guard army, friendly DEATH GUARD units emit Nurgle’s Gift, marking enemies in range afflicted. The encoded first three battle-round ranges are 3″, 6″ and 9″, with a 12″ maximum after modifiers. At Declare Battle Formations choose one plague for the battle: give defenders cover against afflicted enemies’ ranged attacks and impose -1 on their melee Hit rolls; worsen afflicted enemies’ Save by 1; or reduce their Move by 1, worsen Leadership by 1 and reduce Objective Control by 1 to a minimum of 1. All afflicted enemies also lose 1 Toughness. Source review: the note’s flat Hit-penalty shorthand differs from the defensive branch, later-round ranges are not explicit, and leaving-range clearance is undefined; confirm dynamic afflicted-state and choice timing. This ordinary version retains its separate unit scope from Maggot Lords.

For the Maggot Lords units in a Death Guard army, Nurgle’s Gift marks enemies in its contagion aura afflicted: encoded round ranges 3″, 6″ and 9″ with a 12″ cap. At Declare Battle Formations choose one plague for the battle: cover against afflicted ranged attackers and -1 to their melee Hit rolls; worsen afflicted Save by 1; or reduce Move by 1, worsen Leadership by 1 and reduce Objective Control by 1, minimum 1. Afflicted enemies also lose 1 Toughness. Source gap: later-round range, leaving-range clearance and dynamic application after the prebattle choice are not explicit; confirm those procedures. Keep this Maggot Lords version and its five-unit scope distinct from the ordinary rule.
